therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: prevention of multiple myeloma relapse after allogeneic stem cell transplant
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: multiple myeloma patients post-allogeneic stem cell transplant
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: maximum tolerated dose determination and safety assessment

results.effect_size: MTD established at 4 mg with no DLTs observed at any dose level
results.dose_information: 2.3 mg, 3 mg, or 4 mg orally on Days 1, 8, and 15 of each 28-day cycle for 6 cycles

context.duration: 6 cycles of 28 days each (approximately 6 months treatment)
